# Test Fixtures

All fixtures in this directory are generated by this toolchain itself
(`generator` field: `kicad-json5` / `component-db`) and are safe to redistribute.

| File | What it exercises |
| --- | --- |
| `ch340g-usb-uart.kicad_pcb` | Small 2-layer board: footprints, pads, zones, graphics, nets |
| `battery-power-board.kicad_pcb` | 2-layer power board: zones + Edge.Cuts graphics |
| `battery-power-board.kicad_sch` | Schematic produced by the JSON5 → S-expression path |
| `battery-power-board-auto-layout.json5` | JSON5 board-level auto-layout input |

## Optional: HQ EDA demo files

Some `#[ignore]`d integration tests additionally exercise large real-world
boards/schematics from the HQ EDA (华秋 EDA) online ECAD viewer demo set.
These files are **not redistributable** and are therefore not committed.
Download them from the HQ EDA demo page and place them into a directory of
your choice, then run:

```sh
KICAD_JSON5_HQ_DEMO_DIR=/path/to/dir cargo test -- --ignored
```

If the variable is unset, the default lookup path is `../example_sch`
(the layout used during development).
